reply_text:
I found three dated forward-looking claims from 2023, but none is a clean, individually attributed quote from Arthur Mensch. Two come from Mistral's June 2023 fundraising memo. The memo is a company document from the three founders and isn't signed by him personally. The third (an open-source GPT-4-level model in 2024) I only saw as a reporter's paraphrase, with no direct quote and no primary source.

**Candidates**
- **Fundraising memo (leaked June 2023, hosted on SlideShare).** The memo says Mistral will train models at the end of 2023 that "can beat ChatGPT 3.5 and Bard March 2023 by a large margin." It also says Mistral will offer "the best technology within 4 years." These are product targets set for the company's own AI models. It also says that by the end of Q2 2024 Mistral intends to be distributing "the best open-source text-generative model." I left out its fundraising plans (€200M in Q3 2024 to train models beyond GPT-4) because they are business forecasts. The June 2023 date is my guess from the SlideShare thumbnail filename and from public coverage of the seed round.
- **French national radio, around mid-December 2023.** A news repost (from Analytics India Magazine) says he "declared on French national radio that Mistral AI will release an open-source GPT-4 level model in 2024." That rests on a tweet dated 18 December 2023. I never opened the broadcast or a transcript, and I ran out of page openings before I could look for them.

**Undated:** On the No Priors podcast (9 November 2023), he said there is "no evidence whatsoever" that AI is on the way to a singularity. That transcript was made by a machine and garbles names (for example "Arthur Munch", "Mistraw"), so check the exact wording against the recording.

**What I ruled out**
- The Senate hearing blog post turned out to be from May 2024.
- The a16z podcast page (December 2023) has no transcript.
- The Glasp page's "next five years" line is an AI-written summary, not his words.
- Several other dated statements in the results are from 2024 to 2026.

I used 10 of 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
